description: Test case 1: Basic template persistence after Redis cache clear

testCase.name: Basic Template Persistence
validationSteps: Create test template via RPC API POST /v2/activities/templates
Verify template exists in SurrealDB: SELECT * FROM activity_template WHERE variant_id = '{id}'
Verify template cached in Redis: EXISTS activity:template:{id}
Load template via RPC API GET /v2/activities/templates/{id}
Verify Redis cache repopulated: EXISTS activity:template:{id}
Verify logs show cache miss → SurrealDB fallback
successCriteria: Template creation returns 201 Created with variant_id
Template exists in SurrealDB after creation
Template exists in Redis after creation
Template loads successfully after cache clear (HTTP 200)
Logs contain 'Template cache miss' and 'loading from SurrealDB'
